title: Orange recording launch configuration (version 1)
description: recording_snapshot_start.json session.launch_configuration: the configuration the process actually runs on, kept from the moment it was loaded, against the files on disk at this record start. camera_preset is the camera config folder the cameras were last opened from (digest rule orange_camera_config_dir_sha256_v1, the rule of scripts/camera_config_dir_digest.py: every *.json directly in the folder by raw bytes; a symlinked or non-regular *.json is an error); app_config is the app config file as read at launch (SHA-256 of its exact bytes). on_disk_* is recomputed at the record start. configuration_changed_since_launch is true when either differs (changed_since_launch lists which); the start is never refused for it. session.effective_configuration reads the app config file at record start, so when app_config.changed is true its contents are NOT what the process runs on. Written by BuildLaunchConfigurationBlock (src/launch_configuration.cpp) and checked by ValidateEmittedLaunchConfiguration. null camera_preset: no camera preset was recorded at camera open; null app_config: the process loads no app config (headless).

path.description: The folder as the cameras were opened from it.

loaded_at_utc.description: When the cameras were opened from this folder.

changed_files.description: Camera JSONs added, removed or changed since the cameras were opened; empty when either side has no file list.

file_status.description: loaded: read (sha256 set); not_configured: no path; missing: no file at the path; unreadable: open or read failed.

files.description: Per camera JSON, sorted by name: the entries the digest covers.

error.description: Why there is no digest (missing folder, no *.json, a symlinked *.json, ...).
